title: Manatal integration (ATS & HRMS) | Xobin
text:
About Manatal
Manatal is an AI-powered applicant tracking system and recruitment CRM used by in-house teams and agencies. It centralises job management, candidate sourcing, pipeline tracking and client collaboration in a single platform.
Why integrate Manatal with Xobin?
Integrating Manatal with Xobin merges an AI-powered ATS and CRM with advanced skill assessments. You can send tailored assessments directly from Manatal and receive real-time results for quick, data-driven evaluation. Combining Xobin's candidate insight with Manatal's recruitment tools streamlines decision-making, reduces time-to-hire and keeps the best candidates moving forward inside one workflow.

Who is this integration for?
The Manatal and Xobin integration is ideal for HR teams, recruiters and talent acquisition professionals who want to streamline hiring. It is especially valuable for organisations that rely on Manatal's AI-powered ATS and CRM and want to enhance it with in-depth skill assessments. From growing startups to large enterprises, it enables automated candidate evaluation and smarter hiring decisions.
Capabilities
Features & benefits
Stage-driven invites
Moving a candidate into the Send Xobin Assessment stage automatically emails them the mapped assessment.
Job-to-assessment mapping
Link each Manatal job to the right Xobin test, and add as many mappings as you need in one screen.
Automatic stage progression
Completed candidates move themselves into the Xobin Assessment Completed stage, keeping the pipeline accurate.
Scores written to the profile
A note on the Manatal profile carries the score, qualification status and a link to the detailed Xobin report.
Built for multi-client recruiting
Add as many job-to-assessment mappings as you need so each client role runs its own test.
Clean pipeline hygiene
Automatic stage progression keeps the Manatal board accurate without recruiter upkeep.
